subject.title: fix: serialize outbound deliveries per channel+recipient

question: Should maintainers wait for the contributor to repair this draft branch, or sponsor a narrow replacement that preserves the useful ordering fix?
rationale: The bug is real and proof-positive, but the PR is draft and still has delivery/availability blockers, so maintainer intent is needed before adoption or replacement work.

options.title: Wait For Author Repairs
options.body: Keep the draft open for the contributor to rebase and address canonical lane derivation plus abort/stall handling.

options.title: Sponsor Replacement Repair
options.body: A maintainer can promote a narrow replacement that credits this PR and implements the serializer at the safer owner boundary.

options.title: Revisit Later For Cleanup
options.body: If the branch has no new commit or check activity for 30 days while still draft or waiting, it can be reconsidered for abandoned-PR cleanup.

recommendation.title: Wait For Author Repairs
recommendation.body: Keep the draft open for the contributor to rebase and address canonical lane derivation plus abort/stall handling.
